snippet.title: Ryanair Sustainability Day - Pathway to Net Zero @ Trinity College Dublin
snippet.description: Ryanair’s sustainability journey continues! Our CEO, Michael O’Leary, and some key stakeholders headed to Trinity College Dublin to talk about our Pathway to Net Zero with some of the wisest academics and industry leaders from the likes of CFM, Boeing, Shell and Manchester Airport Group. More fuel efficient aircraft, sustainable aviation fuel and operational improvements were just some of the topics covered (check out the Boeing 737 Gamechanger aircraft if you want to see something really awesome!). The team from the Ryanair Sustainable Aviation Research Centre at Trinity gave us even more ideas on how to make aviation sustainable.

snippet.title: A big day in Spain #DividendoDay 🇪🇸
snippet.description:
Spanish regional airports are empty ‼️
So… why is the Government pocketing €834 million from Aena…? 🧐
It’s #DividendoDay! Woohoo!

Instead of stopping the collapse of traffic at Spain’s regional airports caused by a fee system that doesn’t work, the Government prefers to keep absorbing billions of euros in dividends from its monopoly (nearly **€5 billion over the last four years) and look the other way while investment goes into international airports 👎

#DividendoDay #fees #regions #tourism
